query:
SELECT s.id, s.officeId, s.serviceName, s.serviceNameAr, o.officeName 
FROM sanad_office_services s 
JOIN sanad_offices o ON s.officeId = o.id 
WHERE s.serviceName LIKE '%Company Registration%' OR s.serviceName LIKE '%Legal Consultation%' 
LIMIT 10;
